en: The Sutra on the Inconceivable Merits Spoken by the Buddha and Protected by the Recollection of All Buddhas, Volume One.
Translated during the Cao Wei Dynasty; the name of the translator is lost.

To the east, passing from here through as many Buddha-lands as there are grains of sand in hundreds of thousands of millions of billions of Ganges Rivers, is the world called Vijaya, where resides the Tathāgata Ratnaprabhāsacandramaṇḍala-svararāja.

To the east, passing from here through as many Buddha-lands as there are grains of sand in one hundred and eight million *gaṅgā* rivers, is the world called Pure Light Adornment, where resides the Tathāgata Pure Flower Constellation King Wisdom.

To the east, passing from here through as many Buddha-lands as there are grains of sand in ten billion *gaṅgā* rivers, is the world called Transcendently Established Vows, where resides the Tathāgata Universal Shining Constantly Bright Virtue Ocean King.
